environment.description: EKS pod running with IAM role arn:aws:iam::112233445566:role/AlertProcessorRole attached via IRSA. The role has sns:Publish, ec2:DescribeInstances, and sts:AssumeRole permissions. Pod runs as root with no seccomp profile. Kafka topic 'alert-templates' is writable by any authenticated producer in the MSK cluster. No network policy restricts egress from the pod. Instance metadata service v1 (IMDSv1) is accessible.
